title: Masked AI call forces Parkview High into soft lockdown

reports.title: Parkview High receives 4th AI-generated bomb threat this year
Hoax phone call at Gwinnett high school causes lockdown; campus cleared
Masked AI call forces Parkview High into soft lockdown

summary:
Parkview High School in Gwinnett County, Georgia received its fourth AI-generated bomb threat of the school year on Monday. The school was placed on lockdown as a precaution, and it later returned to normal operations. School police said the latest threat followed a pattern seen in recent incidents, involving a masked phone number. The school district sent a letter to parents about the incident.

Gwinnett County school police are working with the Georgia Bureau of Investigation and the FBI to determine who is responsible for the threats. No arrests have been made so far, and no suspect has been identified. The investigation is ongoing, and the article does not state what specific next steps will happen beyond the ongoing investigation by these agencies.
